plants.name: Colchicum autumnale
plants.description: Pale lilac-pink goblets push straight out of bare ground with no leaves in sight. They carpet damp meadows and light up cottage garden borders just as autumn arrives.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early to mid autumn (September to October)
plants.location: Meadows and gardens across Western and Central Europe, including the UK, France and Germany
plants.funFact: Autumn crocus is not a true crocus. It grows from a corm and makes colchicine, a toxic compound that plant breeders use to double the chromosomes of other plants.

plants.name: Symphyotrichum novae-angliae
plants.description: Tall, bushy stems are crowded with daisy-like flowers that have violet petals around golden-yellow centers. In fall, prairies, roadsides and gardens hum with bees and butterflies feeding on them.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to mid autumn (August to October)
plants.location: Eastern and central North America, from New England to the Great Plains
plants.funFact: Monarch butterflies on their long migration to Mexico often stop at New England asters. The nectar gives them fuel for the journey.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Whole streets turn lavender-blue when this tree flowers. Clusters of trumpet-shaped blossoms drop to form a purple carpet underneath.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring in the Southern Hemisphere (October to November), with flowering beginning in late September
plants.location: Pretoria and Johannesburg in South Africa, and Sydney and Brisbane in Australia
plants.funFact: Jacaranda comes from South America. Pretoria is nicknamed the Jacaranda City because it has tens of thousands of the trees lining its streets.
